title: Joe's All Purpose (house rub and seasoning)
description: Joe's house rub and all-purpose seasoning. Mild, smoky, chile-forward. 12 cup batch, single spices only. Yield: about 12 cups (12 pork butt rubs at 1 cup each).

ingredients.note: must be Morton coarse kosher; other salts change saltiness

steps: Measure everything into a large bowl and whisk until the color is even, breaking up any clumps.
Store in a glass jar (or jars) with about 12 cups of space and a tight lid, away from the stove.
Shake the jar before every use (salt and sugar settle).
Pulled pork: about 2 Tbsp per pound, 1 cup for an 8 lb butt. General use: like seasoned salt, lighter than on pork. The sugar can scorch at high heat (skillet, air fry), so watch the edges.
source: Joe Wuest (house blend), finalized with Head Chef; saved at Joe's request via Head Chef, Nov 14, 2026
notes: Mild, smoky, chile-forward. Chipotle carries the smoke and heat; habanero is for fruity flavor, not heat. Reflux-friendly: no citric acid, citrus, tomato, or vinegar powders. No mushrooms (Joe won't eat them). Untested as of Nov 14, 2026: if too warm, cut chipotle to 6 Tbsp; for more habanero flavor, add 1/4 tsp at a time. Related: use 1 cup in pulled pork d5b95a0f8164 in place of the Yellowstone plus Weber rub (that recipe not yet updated; Head Chef will update it after Joe's first cook).
